abstract: Covers JOSE and JWT issuing and verification: RFC 7515 to RFC 7519, RFC 8037 OKP keys, the RFC 8725 JWT Best Current Practices with its rfc8725bis update (-10, build posture), RFC 9864 fully specified algorithms, the none and RSA1_5 deprecation draft (-06, build posture), RFC 9068 JWT access tokens with roles, groups and entitlements, RFC 7638 thumbprints, the RFC 7800 cnf claim, and the IANA JOSE and JWT claims registries. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out the verification checklist, algorithms and keys, and access tokens with the claims registry.
